snippet.title: New UE5 Game Project: Hydro - DEV LOG #2
snippet.description:
Wishlist and get the Demo here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3355830/Hydro/

After a few months of getting to grips with Unreal Engine (starting from nothing), I'm happy to say things have progressed a fair amount! 

I'm hoping you'll enjoy this preview of the game's demo functionality and stay tuned as I'm (hopefully) able develop the title further towards demo/early access/full release. 

Enjoy and please remember to like, comment and subscribe for more updates!
